advisor.query.slow_mean.title: Slow query
advisor.query.slow_mean.detail: mean execution time is {mean_ms} ms over {calls} calls, above the {threshold_ms} ms threshold
advisor.query.slow_mean.remediation: Read its plan and the tables it scans: a missing index, a sequential scan of a large table or a sort spilling to disk are the usual causes
advisor.query.total_time_share.title: Dominant query
advisor.query.total_time_share.detail: this statement takes {share_pct}% of the instance's execution time ({calls} calls, mean {mean_ms} ms)
advisor.query.total_time_share.remediati: Lower its cost or its call rate: read its plan, and check whether the application runs it more often than needed
advisor.query.regression.title: Query regression
advisor.query.regression.detail: mean execution time rose to {mean_ms} ms, {ratio}x its seven-day mean of {base_ms} ms
advisor.query.regression.remediation: Compare its current plan with the plan history: new statistics, a dropped index, data growth or different parameters usually explain a plan change; ANALYZE the tables it reads if their statistics are stale
advisor.query.temp_bytes_high.title: High temporary write volume
advisor.query.temp_bytes_high.detail: average temporary bytes per call is {avg_bytes}
advisor.query.temp_bytes_high.remediatio: Review the query and current work_mem ({work_mem_bytes} bytes)
advisor.query.cache_miss_high.title: High cache miss ratio
advisor.txn.long_running.title: Long-running transaction
advisor.txn.long_running.remediation: Commit, roll back, or investigate the transaction
advisor.txn.idle_in_transaction.title: Idle transaction
advisor.txn.idle_in_transaction.remediat: Close or commit the idle transaction
advisor.txn.prepared_orphan.title: Orphaned prepared transaction
advisor.txn.prepared_orphan.remediation: Resolve the prepared transaction so vacuum can proceed
advisor.txn.high_rollback_ratio.title: High rollback ratio
advisor.txn.high_rollback_ratio.detail: {rollback_pct}% of the transactions of database {database_quoted} rolled back since its statistics were reset, above {threshold_pct}%
advisor.txn.high_rollback_ratio.remediat: Investigate transaction failures and retry behavior
advisor.txn.wraparound_risk.title: Transaction ID wraparound risk
advisor.txn.wraparound_risk.remediation: Run maintenance immediately and resolve vacuum starvation
